questions.text: Does the organisation work in a sector listed in Annex I or II (energy, transport, banking, health, digital infrastructure and others)?
Is it in scope whatever its size (for example a DNS, top-level-domain, trust or public communications provider)?
Does it have 50 or more staff, or more than EUR 10 million turnover or balance sheet?
Does it supply an organisation that is in scope?

outcomes.reason: In-scope customers pass security duties down to their suppliers by contract.
The sector is not listed in the Directive's annexes. Confirm with your adviser.
Entities of this kind are in scope whatever their size.
The organisation is below the size threshold, although national law can still designate an entity. Confirm with your adviser.
